title: improv·artist · vibratory (Ernesto Neto)
mutation_directive: improv artist: vibratory via Ernesto Neto

improv_extras.practice: stretched stocking sacs filled with spice; soft, droopy biomorphism

v1.feedback: The sac silhouettes and ceiling-suspension structure clearly channel Neto, and the cream-ochre palette is a smart spice-fill reference — the idea visibly drove the design. However, additive blending on a near-black background makes these read as glowing deep-sea organisms, not Neto's heavy, opaque, gravity-surrendering fabric; switch to normal blending with a warm off-white or muted gallery-tone background to recover that soft materiality. The sacs are hollow particle shells — scattering some fill particles inside each sac (lower alpha, denser near the belly) would convey the weighted, bulging fullness that defines Neto's forms. The vibratory standing-wave motion is well-tuned in amplitude but could use a slight damping gradient so the attachment zone stays nearly still while the belly and tip carry the oscillation, matching how real suspended weight behaves.

v2.feedback: The spice palette (turmeric, clove, paprika) and sac-profile function with neck/belly/drip-tip clearly channel Neto, and the fill-particle gravity bias selling spice-weight is a smart detail. However, 6K uniformly scattered shell particles per sac will read as soft colored clouds rather than taut stretched stocking membrane — add longitudinal particle chains or visible warp lines running top-to-bottom to evoke the actual fabric tension that defines Neto's forms. The radial symmetry of each sac also flattens the biomorphism; introduce per-sac asymmetric sag (gravity pulling the belly off-center) so the forms read as weighted textile, not parametric blobs.
